newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Contal sees sugar output rising in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Contal sees sugar output rising in 96/97.

text.p: Mexican bottler and sugar miller Grupo Continental (Contal) expects the group's own sugar output will increase 11.6 percent this 1996-1997 harvest over the previous cycle.

Contal, a Coca-Cola bottler with two mills supplying its sugar needs and selling excess, outlined in a report obtained Wednesday that its output will rise to 270,000 tonnes from 242,000 tonnes in the previous November-June sugar cycle.

Contal CFO Miguel Angel Rabaga told Reuters that official crop figures will be released next week. In the 1995-1996 cycle, Contal achieved a cane-sugar yield of 11.6 percent against the industry average of 10.6 percent, Rabaga said.
